text: `intent lang init author` in a fresh project installs `intent/llm/RULES-author.md` and `intent/llm/ARCHITECTURE-author.md`, appends the `author` Language Packs entry to the agnostic `RULES.md`, and adds `author` to `config.json` `languages`.
